question.text: A mineral has molecular formula <math><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></math> . <math><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup></math> ions are arranged in ccp and cations of X are present in octahedral voids. Cations of Y are equally distributed among octahedral and tetrahedral voids. The fraction of the octahedral voids occupied will be

solution.text:
Number of O2- ions = n
Number of tetrahedral voids = 2n
Number of octahedral voids = n
Number of Y ions =n2 ,
Number of X ions =n4
Occupied octahedral voids =n4+n4=n2
So fraction of occupied octahedral voids =12 .
